passives.name: Cryptid Mimicry
passives.description: (Passive) Decreases damage taken from Mages by [Buff_V_tower_element_52751] and increases damage taken from Strikers by [Buff_V_tower_element_52752]. Increases own Priority by [Buff_V_tower_element_52759] after an enemy with Shock takes an action. Also decreases damage and WG damage taken from enemies with Shock by [Buff_V_tower_element_52760]. At the end of the turn, removes [Buff_V_tower_element_52761] buff(s) from enemies with Immunity.
